miracle_ticket: You pocket the miracle. Nobody makes eye contact. This is the way.
A miracle lands in your palm. You nod like this happens every Tuesday.
Free ticket energy. The universe owes you one.
flat_tire: Rubber swapped. Knuckles scraped. Back on the asphalt.
Flat fixed on the shoulder. Your back will file a complaint later.
robbed: Stash lighter. Trust thinner. You roll on anyway.
Someone got to your stuff while you blinked. Par for the course.
Robbed at a rest stop. The tour giveth and taketh.
wook_flu: {name} caught wook flu — tour continues, health doesn't.
Wook flu patient zero: {name}. Rest or hotel before the van becomes a petri dish.
{name} sounds like a sad harmonica. Keep rolling if you dare.
default: You dealt with it and kept rolling.

rest: Camped out so {name} could sleep it off. Health climbing — still contagious until truly recovered.
Rest stop triage for {name}: blankets, bad tea, slow recovery.
Let the fever break. {name}'s bruised but still in the game.
push: {name} powered through wook flu. Health took a beating — vibes in the gutter.
Kept rolling while {name} was sick. Bad idea. They look haunted.
No rest for the wicked — {name} paid in health. Still on the road.
flare: Wook flu flares — the sick crew takes another health hit.
Nobody rested. The outbreak worsens across the van.
Still contagious. Everyone who's sick just took more damage.

busted: You were weaving. Eyes like a disco ball. DUI. Court date. Tour over.
Wasted behind the wheel. They ran the whole playbook. Tour's done.
That was not a vibe they appreciated. Cuffs. Day job awaits.
lie_drugs_gone: You lied while visibly wasted. They found everything. Fines, confiscation, shame.
Story fell apart mid-sentence. Stash gone. Wallet weeping.
lie_fine: Lie + bloodshot eyes = no mercy. Wallet emptied. License unhappy.
They didn't buy it. You pay anyway.
lie_clean: They clocked the wasted energy before you finished the story.
Somehow slid through lying. Don't test it again.
truth_drugs_gone: Honest about the stash while wasted behind the wheel. Bad combo. Everything confiscated.
Truth didn't help. Neither did your pupils.
truth_fine: Miracle you're not in cuffs. Massive fine. Walk the lot sober next time.
Ticket written. You're lucky it's not worse.
truth_clean: Somehow waved on. Do not push your luck again.
They let you go. Unbelievable. Sober up.

busted: They saw through the story. Cuffs. Court date. Tour over.
Lie failed. Badge won. HR is hiring.
lie_drugs_gone: The lie almost worked. They found the stash anyway. Fine + empty pockets.
Almost talked your way out. Almost.
lie_fine: Sketchy energy but they let you go. Wallet lighter. Ego bruised.
lie_clean: You lied. They squinted. You lived. Barely.
Nervous sweat worked as cologne. You're free.
truth_drugs_gone: Honesty didn't save the baggie. Confiscated. Ticket written. Moving on.
truth_fine: Warning and a fine. Officer says "drive safe." You will not.
Small fine. Big attitude from the badge.
truth_clean: Truth told. They wave you on. Heart rate still at encore tempo.

toss_it: Tossed it. Washed your hands twice. No regrets.
Left it for the next poor soul. Walked away clean.
try_it: You tasted the bag in the bathroom. Stash +2. You're wasted now.
Bathroom science experiment. +2 substances. Brain on airplane mode.
One taste became two in the stash and zero dignity.
laced: That shit was laced. You go home and rethink your life.
Wrong bag. Wrong bathroom. Wrong life choices. Day job time.

trade_food: Food handed over. Hitchhiker leans in: "{song}" opens tonight. Bet it yourself if you believe them.
Trail mix for intel — they swear "{song}" is the opener. Your call in the bet panel.
You trade food. They whisper "{song}" like it's classified. Opener tip acquired.
decline: You keep rolling. The hitchhiker melts into the tree line.
No food, no tip. They salute and disappear into the shoulder.
Windows up. Hitchhiker intel stays a mystery.
no_food: No food to trade. Hitchhiker wanted lunch, not vibes.
Hitchhiker wanted food. You had none — opener tip stays unknown.
default: The hitchhiker fades in the rearview.

trade_beer: Beer for gossip — they swear "{song}" hits the set somewhere. Bet it yourself if you buy it.
Lot elder takes your beer and mutters: "{song}" lands tonight. Rumor mill says you're on your own for the wager.
Rumor acquired: "{song}" in the set. Place your own bet when you're ready.
decline: You keep your beer. The rumor mill spins without you.
No trade, no tip. The elder shrugs and melts back into the crowd.
Rumor passes you by. Your cooler approves.
no_beer: No beer to trade. Rumor stays locked in the elder's beard.
Lot elder wanted a beer. You had none.

trade_drugs: Stash tasted, intel delivered: "{song}" closes the encore. Bet it yourself if you're feeling psychic.
They whisper "{song}" for the encore after a taste. Wook gospel — maybe.
Encore tip locked in: "{song}". Your bet slip, your risk.
decline: You keep your stash. The whisper fades into bass frequencies.
No taste, no tip. They wander toward the rail.
Passed on the encore intel. FOMO loading.
no_drugs: No substances to trade. The wook wanted a taste.
Nothing in the stash to offer. Encore tip stays unknown.
default: Encore intel drifts off with the crowd.

drink: {name} cracked a cold one. Thirst down, stoned up.
substances: {name} consumed substances. Vibe and stoned up.
{name} went for it. Vibe up. Stoned up. Questions later.
rest: Crew rested. Stoned meters came down.
Everyone caught a breather and sobered up a bit.
Quick reset by the roadside. Less wasted, back to the grind.
hotel_crash: Hotel crash (${cost}) — fed, quenched, sober. Everyone's human again.
Room booked (${cost}). Hot shower, cold fridge, zero stoned. Crew restored.
Paid ${cost} for real sleep. Hunger, thirst, health, vibe maxed. Sober.
balloons: Balloons — crew vibe up, health a little down.
Nitrous in the lot. Everyone's floating; lungs disagree.
Balloon cart hit. High vibes, sketchy health.

retail: Mafia retail — one hit for $30. Vibe up, health down.
Full price at the skull cart. No haggling, just nitrous.
You pay the clown tax. Crew floats; bodies complain.
deal: Three for ten. The mafia nods. Crew's gone orbital.
You talked them down — three balloons, suspiciously cheap.
Bulk nitrous hustle. Everyone's buzzing; nobody's bleeding. Yet.
deal_punched: You pushed the deal. Skull paint met your jaw. Extra health damage.
Three for ten — then a fist to the mouth for talking too much.
The mafia honored three for ten. Your teeth honored the fine print.

prompt: Undercovers saw the handoff. Sirens incoming.
Badge flash in the lot — someone definitely narced.
Cops materialize like a bad trip. Sale's done; now what?
balloons_prompt: Undercovers clocked the balloon cart. Sirens incoming.
Badge flash by the nitrous guy — someone's talking.
Cops rolled up on the balloon hustle. Vibes were up; now what?
stay: Stayed cool, paid ${fine}. Kept the sale money. Walked away sweaty.
Fine was ${fine}. Cheaper than running. Barely.
Paid ${fine} and acted innocent. Oscar-worthy panic.
run: Ran like encore just started. Lost {stash}.
Sprinted through the lot. Stash became {stash} on the pavement.

push_through_success: Pushed through {legs} leg{s} (~{miles} mi). Crew's shook but you made the lot.
White-knuckled {legs} leg{s}. Lot smells like kettle corn and possibility.
Skipped the scenic suffering. {legs} leg{s} gone. Shakedown awaits.
push_through_need_food: Need {food} food to push through the last {legs} leg(s).
Can't sprint to the lot — need {food} food for {legs} leg{s}.
push_through_need_gas: Need {gas} gas to push through the last {legs} leg(s).
Tank's too low to push through {legs} leg{s}. Need {gas} gas.
burn_gas_success: Windows down. Highway hypnosis. Cruised {legs} leg{s} (~{miles} mi) — no drama, just miles.
Burned a tank stretch and ate {legs} leg{s}. Cupholder yielded a warm beer. Vibes up.
Cruise control engaged. {legs} leg{s} vanished in the rearview. Shakedown's closer.

made_it: Made it into {venue}. Crew intact. The floor was soup.
{venue} swallowed you whole. Good show energy.
chaos_gate: Chaos at the gate. Not everyone got in clean — the night still happened around you.
Gate was a scene. You made it work anyway.
Tickets messy. Show still happened around you.
missed: Missed {venue} — sat out to hustle gas money and sanity.
Skipped {venue} to regroup. The lot will forgive. Maybe.

shuffle: You shuffled on home. The lot will still be there next time.
Tour ended. Couch and questionable leftovers await.
shuffle_blocked: Can't bail yet — play at least one show before going home.
The lot isn't letting you liquidate until you've seen one show.
No early shuffle. Make a show night happen first.
all_bailed: The crew tapped out. Tour over.

wook_flu_death.title: You have "died" of the wook flu.
wook_flu_death.subtitle: (now you have to get a day job)
